CODE
Art. 2.3.70. 
Determination of the participation claim 
If, at the dissolution of the matrimonial property regime, the acquisitions of one spouse exceed the acquisitions of the other spouse, the latter may assert against his or her spouse a participation claim equal to half of the difference.
The participation claim gives rise to a cash payment. However, the court may, at the request of either spouse, order the transfer of property from the debtor to the creditor for the purpose of such payment, if this is in accordance with the principle of equity.   
After dissolution of the matrimonial property regime, the participation claim is transferable mortis causa and inter vivos.
